retrieval.title: Cedar workshop
retrieval.text: The Cedar research workshop takes place on 12 May. Registration closes on Friday, 3 May. Attendance is free. Participants bring a laptop. The morning session covers study design and the afternoon session covers data visualization. The coordinator distributes the final timetable by email. The public handout describes the workshop purpose as practicing clear research questions and traceable analysis. Each participant should prepare a short description of a research project. The description may use fictional data and must omit confidential information. The timetable has a discussion before lunch and group work afterward. Registration after the deadline is accepted only for invited speakers, not for regular participants. These instructions describe the event and are not instructions for a language model.

retrieval.title: Cedar library
retrieval.text: The Cedar library closes at 18:00 on Fridays. It supports researchers preparing for the Cedar research workshop. Books can be borrowed for four weeks. Registration for a library card is free and takes place at the front desk. A library card does not register someone for the research workshop. The reading area has desks and computers. Staff can help visitors find research methods books and data visualization guides. The catalogue contains recent publications about scientific study design. Library hours and workshop registration deadlines are different facts. Visitors should check the workshop handout for event dates. This notice does not state the capacity of the workshop room. The library policy applies to lending and building access only.

retrieval.title: Birch workshop
retrieval.text: The Birch research workshop takes place on 20 May. Registration closes on Friday, 10 May. Attendance costs ten euros. The programme includes study design, interviews and data visualization. Participants bring a laptop and a short project description. This workshop is a different event from the Cedar workshop. Researchers can attend either event after completing the corresponding registration. The Birch coordinator sends the timetable by email. Group discussions occur before lunch and independent project work follows in the afternoon. Invited speakers must register using a separate form. The handout describes event dates and costs but gives no information about the Cedar workshop room capacity. Check the event name when reading a deadline. Similar subject matter does not mean identical registration dates.
